title: Running Streamlit with Starlette in Corporate Network
body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar issues.
- [x] I added a very descriptive title to this issue.
- [x] I have provided sufficient information below to help reproduce this issue.

### Summary

I am not sure if my comment in #15400 is considered, but as stated there, I tested the wheel file in the fix as well as streamlit-nightly and i am still facing the same issue as reported in #15378, I cannot use Streamlit with the update to Starlette anymore. If possible I would like to open this topic again.
